name: SoundCloud

sources.title: SoundCloud signup — JS-only app shell; account creation requires JavaScript
SoundCloud company contact page — confirms platform is music/audio streaming for artists and fans

requirements: Platform is for music/audio creators and fans — a SaaS product has no native listing surface; the play is a branded profile page with a bio link
Account creation happens entirely in the JavaScript app at soundcloud.com/signup — no server-rendered form
Free tier ('Go' listener / basic artist account) suffices for a profile; paid Next/Go+ plans are for upload limits and distribution, not required for presence
preparation: Display name / artist name for the product or company
Square avatar image and header/banner image
Short bio and the product website URL for the profile links section
workflow: Open https://soundcloud.com/signup in a JS-capable browser and create an account
Complete the profile: upload avatar and banner, write bio, add website URL under profile links
Optionally upload one piece of audio (e.g. a podcast/audio teaser) so the profile is not empty
Verify the public profile URL renders at soundcloud.com/<handle> with the website link visible
watchFor: No directory or 'submit a product' flow exists — this is a profile/citation play, not a launch listing
Profile bio/links may be nofollow — do not assume a followed backlink
A bare profile with no audio and a marketing-only bio can look like spam; add at least one upload
Signup page is a JS app shell — automation must drive a real browser
countsAsLive: Public profile page at soundcloud.com/<handle> loads for a logged-out visitor and shows the bio plus outbound website link
unknowns: Whether profile website links are follow or nofollow
Current free-plan upload limits (plan details live behind the JS app)
Whether SoundCloud moderates or removes brand-only accounts
